deploy-bot: RC created by @release-manager: rc-1.4.0-20260320
deploy-bot: artifact sha: ab12cd34ef56, build: 20260320.1, tests: unit+smoke passed

Alice M.: change window is 21:00-23:00 PST tonight, confirmed?
Bob K.: yes, ops confirmed maintenance window, infra is oncall for the window :white_check_mark:
Carol S.: QA smoke ran on staging, two flaky tests flagged (search-index and auth-token). I've muted flaky search-index for now, auth-token failure looks config related, re-running.
QA-Leah: re-run passed for auth-token. smoke green.
release-manager: ok we need signoff from infra, QA, and product before promotion. Product-Jin, any objections to promoting this RC?
Product-Jin: no objections, change includes cost-optimizations, retry fixes, and the new batching knob. We should call it out in the release notes.
infra-oncall: ramped capacity for the dedicated pools by +20% for first 30m of rollout. Verified GPU quotas in region us-west-2.
Dave R.: rolling canary plan: 5% traffic 15m -> evaluate errors/latency -> 50% 10m -> 100% if stable. Rollback window 40m total from first canary start.
Alice M.: rollback plan: if errors > 1% or latency p95 increases by >200ms for more than 5m, abort and rollback to 1.3.9 pinned. Manual rollback command: `deploy rollback --to 1.3.9 --force --reason "canary regression"`
release-manager: noted. Also pin artifact in registry with tag `rc-1.4.0-staged` before promote.
Carol S.: FYI test harness found a minor mismatch in structured logs for user-id anonymization, nonblocking but logging change request created: LOGS-342. Not a blocker for deploy.
release-manager: requesting final thumbs: @QA-Leah, @infra-oncall, @Product-Jin, @Alice M.
QA-Leah: :thumbsup: approved
infra-oncall: :thumbsup: approved
Product-Jin: :thumbsup: approved
Alice M.: :shipit: from eng side
release-manager: initiating promote now. Command: `/deploy promote rc-1.4.0-20260320 --to prod --canary 5% --pin rc-1.4.0-staged`
deploy-bot: Promotion accepted. Starting canary: 5% traffic, duration 900s. Canary id: canary-2030004001-a
deploy-bot: health checks: 0/3 errors, avg p95 latency delta +18ms, token usage within normal bounds
Carol S.: monitoring dashboards - error rate flat, no spike in 5m
Bob K.: traces look clean, no SLO breaches
20m later - deploy-bot: canary stage complete. Metrics OK. Proceeding to 50% for 10m.
deploy-bot: promoted to 50% traffic
infra-oncall: autoscaler trimmed up successfully, no queue growth
release-manager: hold 10m to watch latency then finish.
10m later - Carol S.: still green, sampling looks good. No increase in 5xx.
release-manager: rolling to 100% now.
deploy-bot: promoted to 100% traffic. Pinning artifact rc-1.4.0-staged -> prod-latest.
deploy-bot: deployment complete. Post-deploy checks running (5m).
deploy-bot: post-deploy checks OK. Release notes draft posted to #release-notes: "rc-1.4.0: batching improvements, retry logic, cost perf tweaks. See LOGS-342 for logging change."
Product-Jin: adding a short blurb to the changelog and notifying customers in the scheduled digest.
Carol S.: closing QA ticket for this RC, will run a broader regression set tomorrow morning.
Alice M.: thanks team. If any regression appears, follow rollback command and ping infra-oncall and release-manager. :rotating_light:
QA-Leah: noted, will run targeted evals and watch quality dashboard for 24h.
release-manager: officially: rc-1.4.0 promoted to prod at ts 2030004101. Thanks everyone.
